response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong general engineering credentials, but his background is fundamentally misaligned with this Principal Performance Architect role. He has no demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator or GPU architecture, deep-learning workload optimization, or hardware-software co-design. His closest relevant work — low-latency DLang services and brief C/C++ IDE component work — is systems-adjacent but far from silicon-level performance architecture at a principal level.
strengths: 15+ years of software engineering experience, meeting the general experience bar
Some low-latency, high-throughput systems work (async I/O, fibers, caching at Sociomantic)
Strong engineering craftsmanship, open-source contributions, and knowledge-sharing track record
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, silicon architecture, or hardware performance modeling experience
No deep-learning training/inference optimization, GPU, or SIMD/MIMD architecture background
Career trajectory is web/product-focused, not principal-level hardware performance architecture

key_factors.factor: No SoC/IP modeling or hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / DNN workload optimization background
Solid general engineering seniority and systems fundamentals
